prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 18 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1441; do not mention it.)
text:
Treatment Summary

The patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which their vehicle was sideswiped while changing lanes. At initial evaluation, the patient reported acute neck pain with stiffness, pain radiating into the trapezius region, and headaches that were worse in the morning. Range of motion of the cervical spine was reduced in rotation and lateral flexion, with palpable muscle guarding over the paraspinal musculature. Neurological screening was within normal limits, with no motor deficits, sensory changes, or reflex abnormalities noted.

Diagnosis: cervical strain with associated myofascial pain.

Over the course of 18 scheduled visits, care included manual therapy, soft tissue mobilization, therapeutic exercise for cervical stabilization and range of motion, postural education, and home exercise instruction. The patient showed steady improvement in pain levels and range of motion, with headache frequency decreasing substantially by the midpoint of treatment. At the most recent visit, the patient reported near-resolution of symptoms and was able to return to normal daily and occupational activities without restriction.

Prognosis is good. The patient has been advised to continue the home exercise program and to return if symptoms recur.
